sources.entry: ZenTao - An agile(scrum) project management system/tool. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: ZenTao is an open-source, all-in-one project management system from China covering product, project, QA, documentation, and office management, built around Scrum, Waterfall, and Kanban models.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes ZenTao as a comprehensive platform spanning the main project management process, from product and project management through quality management, documentation management, organization management, and office management. It states that the management model is built on Scrum, Waterfall, and Kanban methodologies. It defines separate product, project, and QA concepts so product owners, developers, and testers can coordinate, tracking work through stories, tasks, and bugs. Modules mentioned include data visualization, measurement, DevOps, document asset management, and automated testing. The README also describes paid editions (ZenTao Biz, ZenTao Max, and ZenTao Cloud SaaS) with additional features such as operations and maintenance management, feedback management, CMMI support, and automatic cloud backups. The README gives no installation instructions.
use_cases: waterfall project planning with stage control
coordinating product owners, developers and testers
document and asset management for teams
notable: Supports Scrum, Waterfall, and Kanban methodologies in one system
Separate product, project, and QA concepts with stories, tasks, and bugs
Covers product, project, quality, documentation, and office management in one platform
Described as the first open-source project management software in China, active since 2009
caveats: Advanced features (operations management, CMMI support, risk management) are in paid editions ZenTao Biz and ZenTao Max
README gives no self-hosting or installation instructions
Licensed under AGPL and ZPL per README; commercial editions offered for enhanced features
keywords: track bugs and tasks for my team
